_comment: Committed, machine-portable Claude Code settings. Per-user permissions and ComfyUI-loader smoke test live in settings.local.json (gitignored). Hook commands use ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} so they work on any clone.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "example_workflows/.*\\.json"; then echo "NOTICE: direct workflow-JSON edit. Convention is that workflow changes go through scripts/apply_*.py (idempotent, reviewable). Proceed only if this is a one-off tweak; otherwise consider writing or extending an apply script." >&2; fi'

bash -c 'path=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE "example_workflows/[^\"]+\\.json" | head -1); if [ -n "$path" ]; then cd ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} && python3 scripts/test_workflow_integrity.py "$path"; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "nodes\\.py\\|nodes_analysis\\.py\\|__init__\\.py"; then echo "WARNING: nodes.py schema changed. Existing workflows may have stale slot indices. Users must delete and re-add modified nodes in ComfyUI."; fi'

bash -c 'cd ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} && f="internal/log/log_$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md"; if [ ! -f "$f" ] || ! grep -q "$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" "$f"; then echo "REMINDER: no session-log entry for $(date +%Y-%m-%d). Append one to $f (doc-conventions: ALWAYS update session log before finishing a session or iteration of work)." >&2; fi'
